tasks.title: Conversation #93
tasks.transcript:
Woman: I finally finished reading that novel you recommended.
Man: Oh, the hidden path? What did you think of it?
Woman: It was incredible the plot twist kept me on the edge of my seat. I couldn't put it down.
Man: I know, right? The author did a fantastic job with character development too.
Woman: Definitely. I'm looking forward to reading more books by her.
Man: Me too. I heard her next book is coming out next month.

questions.stem: What aspect of the novel does the woman talk about?
questions.analysis: 答案：B 题目问的是：女士谈到了小说的哪个方面？ 定位原文：Woman: It was incredible – the plot twist kept me on the edge of my seat. I couldn't put it down. 选项分析： A. Its beautiful illustrations 它精美的插图。对话中未提及插图，所以A选项错误。 B. Its surprising plot developments 它出人意料的剧情发展。女士明确提到“plot twist”（情节转折）让她一直悬着心，所以B选项正确。 C. Its historical context 它的历史背景。对话中未提及历史背景，所以C选项错误。 D. Its humorous dialogue 它幽默的对话。对话中未提及对话风格，所以D选项错误。

questions.stem: What does the man say about the author?

options.B: She is publishing another book soon.
options.D: She is an illustrator as well.

questions.analysis: 答案：B 题目问的是：男士对作者说了什么？ 定位原文：Man: I heard her next book is coming out next month. 选项分析： A. She has an international audience. 她有国际读者群。对话中未提及读者范围，所以A选项错误。 B. She is publishing another book soon. 她很快就要出版另一本书了。男士明确说她的下一本书下个月就要出版了，所以B选项正确。 C. She writes mostly non-fiction. 她主要写非虚构作品。对话中讨论的是小说（novel），且未提及其他类型，所以C选项错误。 D. She is an illustrator as well. 她也是一位插画师。对话中未提及插画，所以D选项错误。
